key.name: enabled
key.description: Master toggle. When false, no hints are shown.

key.name: seen-hints
key.description: Each id is recorded when the coach-mark is first shown and never repeats until Replay.

key.name: hint-alttab
key.description: Off by default: GNOME already handles Alt+Tab, and a bubble after the switcher can nag.

key.name: hint-window-controls
key.description: Off by default: firing on the first window feels like a tour.
